description: A practical software-building workflow toolkit inspired by gstack: product discovery, plan reviews, root-cause debugging, QA, security checks, and release verification.

defaultPrompt: Help me challenge and clarify a product idea before implementation.
Review my implementation plan for architecture, edge cases, and tests.
Run an evidence-based code review or release-readiness checklist.
interface.longDescription: A skills-first toolkit inspired by the public gstack project. It guides product discovery, scope and architecture reviews, evidence-based code review, root-cause debugging, QA/security planning, and safe release verification. It provides workflow guidance, not gstack's local binaries, browser runtime, or agent-specific slash commands.

name: gstack-workflow-toolkit
